overview: S3A is the tab-completion response channel, and the flagging half of the domain runs on the request side: Grim's ChatA and CrashH and BetterAnticheat's ImpossibleCompletionCheck read the inbound WrapperPlayClientTabComplete (C14) and are documented on that packet's page. Only Intave consumes the outbound response, and both consumers are suggestion filters rather than flaggers: CommandFilter strips Intave's own commands out of the completion list and VanishFilter removes hidden players' names. The rest of the corpus is plumbing and noise: FlopAC's WrappedInTabComplete and WrappedOutTabComplete wrappers, Artemis' PacketRepository entry with the GPacketPlayServerTabComplete wrapper, Negativity's TAB_COMPLETE constants, SafeguardAC's compiled-only TabComplete check, and Bukkit TabCompleter implementations in every anticheat's own command system.

checks.name: CommandFilter (Intave)
checks.purpose: Keeps Intave's own commands out of tab-complete responses so players without the intave.command permission cannot discover them by pressing Tab.
checks.how_it_works: Subscribes to TAB_COMPLETE_OUT (S3A) and reads the response's string array. For players without the intave.command permission it rebuilds the array, dropping every suggestion that contains /intave or /iac, and writes the filtered array back into the packet only when something was removed. The same filter's inbound method rewrites /iac and /intave chat and tab-complete requests into a forwarder command; that half runs on C14 and is documented on that page.
checks.detects: Leakage of Intave's commands through tab completion; it also hides the anticheat's presence from players probing with Tab.
checks.variations: The only anticheat that rewrites outbound tab-complete suggestions. VanishFilter is the sibling filter in the same module that strips hidden player names instead of commands.

checks.name: VanishFilter (Intave)
checks.purpose: Removes hidden players from tab-complete responses so vanished staff do not leak through name completion.
checks.how_it_works: Subscribes to TAB_COMPLETE_OUT (S3A) at MONITOR priority, reads the response's string array, and rebuilds it without the names of online players whose UUIDs are not in the viewer's shownPlayers set. The set is maintained by the same filter's PLAYER_INFO (S38) handler, which hides and shuffles the viewer's tab list.
checks.detects: Vanished players exposed by tab completion; the filter is a privacy measure for staff, not a cheat flag.
checks.variations: CommandFilter is the sibling filter that strips command suggestions; both run on TAB_COMPLETE_OUT.
